scope: Saved workflow-role choices list readable names and local connection IDs through authenticated Suite HTTP without returning native session/account credentials or dispatching a command.

Companion mode, original workspace selection, provider policy and existing intent validation filter the inventory. Copilot-only Work offers only its permitted documented surface; unsupported or stale actions are absent.

An opaque state digest binds role, policy, enrolled accounts, original session/capabilities and prior role binding to the saved workspace-selection generation. It is a concurrency check, not an approval token.

The selected local binding is saved under the original state lease after fresh checks. Session/role/permission/rebinding/selection drift and replay of a consumed choice refuse without a state write. Heartbeats alone do not invalidate a supported current connection.
Real encrypted storage and authenticated HTTP compose in the fixtures. Ambiguous/oversized inventories refuse completely, and original physical dispatch/legacy bind paths retain their checks.
limitations: Installed 9d230ac and the accepted complete Linux 7f2a52a run predate these guided-role routes. Prepared installed verifier checks have not run yet.
Listing saved candidates does not observe a current provider/account or prove native availability. Future dispatch retains its original policy/session and action-specific review.
Frontend picker/command activation, live provider/account/task actions, interactive Windows and physical-device acceptance remain separate.
